verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI coding agent, but the evidence documents no built-in scheduler or recurring-trigger feature. What it does show is one-off execution: `opencode run` commands, comment-triggered GitHub Actions tasks, and a headless `serve` server with an SDK. Running these on a schedule via cron or GitHub Actions would be a user-side workaround or a host-platform capability, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
